description: This file defines a utility enum LogLocator that manages log file paths and retrieval logic for log management in a macOS application. It includes methods for determining the log directory, finding the latest log file, and providing paths for launch daemon stdout/stderr logs.

classes.name: LogLocator
classes.description: A utility enum that provides static methods and properties to locate, manage, and retrieve log files for the application.

methods.name: logDir
methods.description: Computes the URL of the log directory, either from an environment variable or defaults to /tmp/openclaw.

methods.name: stdoutLog
methods.description: Returns the URL for the stdout log file within the log directory.

methods.name: gatewayLog
methods.description: Returns the URL for the gateway log file within the log directory.

methods.name: ensureLogDirExists
methods.description: Creates the log directory if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: modificationDate
methods.description: Retrieves the last modification date of a specified URL (log file).

methods.name: bestLogFile
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent log file from the log directory based on modification date, filtering by prefix.

methods.name: launchdLogPath
methods.description: Provides the path for launchd to redirect stdout/err logs.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Provides the path for the Gateway launchd job logs.
